internal.title: Incident Resolved: Accounting Service Kafka Consumer Lag
internal.body:
At 11:27 UTC, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service, indicating a queue backlog issue with a lag of 5200 records. The diagnosis confirmed the backlog as the root cause. A mitigation action was taken by disabling the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 11:47 UTC after approval. Recovery was verified shortly after, with the consumer lag returning to normal levels.

No other services were found to be the root cause, although error injections were proposed as hypotheses for checkout and frontend services. The incident was resolved without further impact.

Action taken:
- Disabled kafkaQueueProblems flag to alleviate backlog

Recovery verified by monitoring Kafka consumer lag metrics.

Severity: SEV1

external.title: Service Interruption Resolved for Accounting Service
external.body: Between 11:27 and 11:47 UTC, the accounting service experienced a delay due to a backlog in processing messages. This caused temporary service degradation. The issue was identified and resolved by our operations team, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent similar issues in the future.
